# Advisories pip-audit may pass over, one per line: the ID, then why. An entry needs a reason a
# reader can check and a date to look again. With no entry, any known vulnerability fails CI.
#
# PYSEC-2026-2447 (CVE-2025-69872), diskcache 5.6.3, found 2026-11-11. diskcache reads pickles
# from its cache folder, so someone who can write to that folder can run code. No fixed version
# exists. It's only in the snapshot-purge image, pulled in by DVC, where the cache folder sits
# inside the job's own container and nothing else writes to it. Anyone able to write there
# already controls the job. Look again by 2027-02-11, or when DVC drops or updates diskcache.
PYSEC-2026-2447
